_note: Static catalog seed (offline tests + demo bootstrap). Every score traces to a dated benchmark source and every price to a published price table — no figure here is invented. TASK MODEL (P38c, 2026-09-07): ONE benchmark and ONE metric per task_type, enforced as a hard invariant by catalog.service.upsert_catalog_row and app.recommend.scoring (it replaced a 'group with the most rows wins' vote, which let row COUNTS decide the recommendation). The three groups: (1) 'ci_review' / CodeReviewBench / review_score_percent — a JUNE 2026 SNAPSHOT (see the benchmark_notes on those rows), the task the CI review agent performs; (2) 'security_analysis' / RealVuln / f3_score — generated by app.catalog.ingest_realvuln from the benchmark's own machine-readable reports/dashboard.json + llm-bench/config/models.yaml (Apache-2.0, kolega-ai/Real-Vuln-Benchmark @ 248ffed0b940), DO NOT hand-edit those rows; (3) 'agentic_coding' / SWE-bench Verified / pass@1_percent — DATA-ONLY breadth, never recommended over. The synthetic Nova 2 Lite review score that used to sit in group (1) was DROPPED in P38c: it was the only uncited figure in this file. Nova 2 Lite keeps its real SWE-bench row and remains our in-cluster chat model. PRICING: input/output per-MTok split prices are what the S12 savings engine bills; cost_per_mtok is a blended scalar used ONLY for ranking and display, DERIVED by the upsert as (3*input + output)/4 (a review reads a large diff and emits compact findings) — never hand-enter it. BASELINES are per task (BASELINE_MODEL_IDS): Claude Sonnet 4.5 for ci_review, Claude Opus 5 for security_analysis; each must be a scored row in its own group. _note and _provenance are FILE-LOCAL: CatalogRowIn ignores unknown keys, so they never reach the DB, the API or the chat — the persisted `source` is the only provenance users see.

benchmark_results.source: RealVuln v2.1.0 https://github.com/kolega-ai/Real-Vuln-Benchmark (F3 67.7, micro-averaged over 66 repos, generated 2026-08-24, run under Claude Code); Anthropic pricing https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing ($5 in / $25 out per MTok)
benchmark_results.benchmark_notes: Recall-weighted F3 over 66 real Python repositories with 1,903 curated vulnerabilities (Apache-2.0). Agentic scanners run a multi-turn loop over a read-only checkout and emit Semgrep-shaped findings. F3 weights recall 3x precision: for a security scanner a missed vulnerability costs more than a false positive. Harness matters and is recorded per row — the same model scores differently under different agent loops.
